legality_and_lifetime_findings: TQ=BQ/(WM*WN*8)=1 and TK=BK/8=1 meet the existing fragment static_asserts. All public depths are multiples of8.
Actual BlockLoaderT writes scalar logical elements through kDstStrRow/kDstStrCol, including paged and Q8 loaders. It has no ReadVector16-byte row-padding prerequisite.
For BCOLS64/128/256,32threads cover8rows with16/32/64 reads each, TCOLS4 and TROWS8. Destination elements are unique and bounded exactly as the recorded max indices.
Each Q8 n_reads value meets the existing complete32-element block fast-loader divisibility predicate. Invalid tail rows follow existing zero-fill branches without indexing a nonexistent logical page.

MMATile.load invokes BaseMMAFrag.load using explicit strides and scalar element casts. Both writers and readers derive all layout offsets from the same pad values; changing all three pads together keeps the logical matrix mapping.

Q has independent storage. K and V retain intentional shared max-sized storage and all barriers before consumption, overwrite and next-iteration writes. No new global/result alias or ownership object.
NQ/NK/rem, align_Q/K, specialization cache identity and grid/group must be recomputed for the final selected tile. Logical GQA, causal/window/page indices and output-tail checks are unchanged.

Small nonempty K is supported by the existing safe/paged/Q8 zero-fill and score-mask branches. Full noncausal Q>K remains allowed. Existing public admission rejects nonempty Q withK0 and causal Q>K; empty Q is skipped before this full-kernel path. No new restriction on small M/K is introduced.

Preserve Q8 T=float, original F16 QueryT=half, original BF16 QueryT=float and F32 accumulation. A smaller BK can change floating-point grouping, so original numerical tolerances/oracles remain necessary.

Resource check must precede set_compute_pipeline_state/current-kernel bindings/dispatch. Original and the sole compact candidate both require actual pipeline static-memory checks; existing thread-limit check moves before binding without adding a duplicate read.
Original unchanged shader ABI requires dynamic_threadgroup_bytes=0; original encoder dynamic history remainsNOT_OBSERVED. No CommandEncoder binding reset or generic state change is justified.

If both returned pipelines do not fit, original exception-to-Status, accepted-prefix stream drain, first-error preservation, native permission retirement and notification lifetime must remain. This is not a successful support verdict for a valid shape. Arbitrary JIT/OOM exceptions must not be swallowed as resource evidence.
